# MLA Style Center

> The only authorized web resource for Modern Language Association (MLA) style guidance, offering free comprehensive documentation on citations, academic writing, and research practices.

The MLA Style Center provides educators, students, and researchers with official guidance on MLA formatting standards, including works-cited citations, in-text citations, and academic integrity. The site offers interactive tools, sample essays, teaching resources, and expert advice to support proper documentation and ethical academic writing practices.

## Key Topics

- MLA Style
- Works Cited
- Citation Format
- MLA Handbook
- In-Text Citations
- Academic Writing
- Research Writing
- Documentation Standards
- Academic Integrity
- Teaching Resources
- AI Literacy
- Plagiarism
- MLA International Bibliography
- Citation Guide
- Student Guide

## Citation & Documentation

- [Citations by Format](https://style.mla.org/works-cited/citations-by-format): Guide to MLA citations organized by source format with real examples.
- [Works Cited: A Quick Guide](https://style.mla.org/works-cited/works-cited-a-quick-guide): Quick reference guide to MLA works-cited format and core elements.
- [Interactive Practice Template](https://style.mla.org/interactive-practice-template): Interactive tool for practicing MLA works-cited list formatting.
- [How do I format a quotation of song lyrics?](https://style.mla.org/formatting-song-lyrics): Guide to formatting song lyric quotations in MLA style.

## Learning & Practice

- [Sample Essays: Writing with MLA Style](https://style.mla.org/sample-papers): Sample student essays demonstrating MLA style formatting.
- [Quizzes](https://style.mla.org/quizzes-2): Interactive grammar and punctuation quizzes for skill assessment.
- [Exploratory Research in the MLA International Bibliography: "News Reporting" and Contemporary Society](https://style.mla.org/lesson-plan-exploratory-research): Lesson plan for exploratory research using MLA International Bibliography.

## Academic Integrity & Writing Guidance

- [Plagiarism and Academic Dishonesty](https://style.mla.org/plagiarism-and-academic-dishonesty): Guide to understanding plagiarism and maintaining academic integrity.
- [Advice from the Editors](https://style.mla.org/sections/advice-from-the-editors): Writing tips and grammar advice from MLA Style Center editors.
- [Student Guide to AI Literacy](https://style.mla.org/student-guide-to-ai-literacy): Educational guide to AI literacy and ethical use of generative AI.

## Teaching & Resources

- [Teaching Resources](https://style.mla.org/sections/teaching-resources): Collection of lesson plans and teaching materials for MLA instruction.
- [AI Resources](https://style.mla.org/ai-resources): Resources for citing generative AI and teaching AI literacy.
- [Submit Your Teaching Resource](https://style.mla.org/submit-a-teaching-resource): Guidelines for submitting teaching resources to MLA Style Center.

## Support & Community

- [Ask the MLA](https://style.mla.org/sections/ask-the-mla): FAQ section answering common questions about MLA style and citations.
- [Submit an Essay to "Writing with MLA Style"](https://style.mla.org/writing-with-mla-style): Submission guidelines for the Writing with MLA Style essay program.

## Products & Handbooks

- [What is MLA Handbook Plus?](https://style.mla.org/what-is-mla-handbook-plus): Overview of MLA Handbook Plus digital product and features.

## Optional

- [What's New in the Ninth Edition of the MLA Handbook (Spring 2021)](https://style.mla.org/ninth-edition-whats-new): Summary of changes in MLA Handbook ninth edition.
- [Paige Eggebrecht Archives](https://style.mla.org/authors/paige-eggebrecht): Author archive page for Paige Eggebrecht's contributions.
